restaurant_name: The Loft Clinic เซ็นทรัลพัทยา
text:
Today is finally the day to review The Loft Clinic! 😊 I was impressed from the start by Khun Koy, a sales representative who provided excellent advice to someone completely unfamiliar with any procedures. She patiently listened to my needs, calmly explained each machine in detail, and recommended which machine would be best suited for me. Then came the consultation with Dr. Bas. Dr. Bas was incredibly patient and kind; listening to his recommendations was so relaxing. My first treatment was Ulthera 500 Lines, with a promotional offer including Red Touch Pro 200 Lines. Dr. Bas performed the procedure meticulously, constantly asking if I was okay and if it hurt. Just hearing his voice gave me the courage to persevere! 🤣😅 I'm very satisfied with the results.

My second visit was for a follow-up 5 months after my first Ulthera treatment, as I needed my face to look great quickly. This time I met with Dr. Ink. Dr. Ink explained both the machine and injectable treatments in detail, clearly differentiating the differences, and recommended a procedure that perfectly matched my needs, limitations, and conditions. This time, we did the MPT 600 line and got a free Volnewmer 600 line. The results were even more noticeably lifted immediately after the treatment.

Plus, the sales representative, Khun Koy, was so kind to let us try Pico Toning as well (we understand that the freebies are based on purchase amounts and monthly promotions). But Dr. Ink also included Pico Toning, which helps with freckles and melasma, as a freebie. Since our skin needs time to scab over after the treatment, and we'd never had any procedures before, we were incredibly paranoid and stressed for the first week (Dr. Ink said the process would improve in two weeks... You need to trust the process 😅). But Khun Koy, Dr. Ink, and the clinic took amazing care of us. They answered all our questions and concerns, provided assistance, followed up on our progress, and gave us medication to reduce irritation. Our skin looks amazing now! All that's left is the minor touch-up on the freckles and melasma from the Pico Toning, which Dr. Ink will schedule weekly checkups for.

I want to clarify that I'm not a paid endorser; I paid for everything myself. But I'm writing this review because I'm truly touched and impressed by the care at The Loft Clinic. Thank you to sales representative Koya for being so patient with me, even though I was a bit moody and sulky at times before I finally trusted the process 🤣😘 Thank you for being so understanding towards a newcomer like me. Thank you for making visiting the clinic so comfortable and allowing me to choose my own beauty treatments without anyone pressuring me to buy courses. Thank you to Dr. Bas and Dr. Ing for choosing treatments that were perfect for my skin, needs, and age. And finally, thank you to all the staff at the clinic who were always so cheerful and smiling every time I visited. (The clinic has many price options and courses to choose from, so you can find something that suits your budget. Sales representative Koya is lovely; please be kind to her!) 😉☺️
